source: **A photo library that organizes millions of photos on its own, that no server can see into, and that shares across servers the way email does.** Capsule is open source and end-to-end encrypted, built for people who shoot thousands of pictures a year, photographers whose RAW files are their livelihood, travellers bringing the world home on a memory card, and families keeping decades of memories. Run it on your own server or a friend's, and share with anyone, on any server.
target: **一個能自行整理數百萬張相片、任何伺服器都無法窺看其內容，並且像電子郵件一樣跨伺服器分享的相片庫。** Capsule 開源且端對端加密，專為這些人打造：每年拍攝數千張相片的人、以 RAW 檔維生的攝影師、用一張記憶卡把世界帶回家的旅人，以及珍藏數十年回憶的家庭。您可以在自己或朋友的伺服器上執行它，並與任何伺服器上的任何人分享。

source:
> [!NOTE]
> **Alpha.** Mobile clients are being stabilized and refined prior to distribution to beta testers. Follow along on the [roadmap](ROADMAP.md).
target:
> [!NOTE]
> **Alpha 階段。** 行動用戶端正在穩定與改進中，之後將提供給 Beta 測試人員。請在[路線圖](ROADMAP.md)上追蹤進度。

source: ## Why Capsule
target: ## 為什麼選擇 Capsule

source: - **Organize millions of photos, systematically and automatically.** Every import lands on one timeline, RAW+JPEG pairs and bursts\* are stacked, duplicates are caught by their content, and smart albums keep themselves up to date. A library of millions stays as easy to navigate as one of hundreds.
target: - **系統化、自動化地整理數百萬張相片。** 每次匯入都會進入同一條時間軸，RAW+JPEG 配對與連拍\*會自動堆疊，重複的相片依內容辨識，智慧相簿會自行保持最新。即使有數百萬張相片，相片庫瀏覽起來也和只有幾百張時一樣輕鬆。

source: - **Private by construction, not by promise.** Photos are encrypted on your devices before they leave. The server stores only ciphertext and never holds a key, so not even whoever runs it can look.
target: - **隱私來自設計，而非承諾。** 相片在離開您的裝置之前就已加密。伺服器只儲存密文，從不持有金鑰，因此即使是伺服器的營運者也無法查看。

source: - **Proof of where every photo came from.** Each photo carries a signed history of who captured, imported and edited it, so its origin can be verified rather than trusted.
target: - **每張相片的來源都有憑有據。** 每張相片都帶有簽章的歷史紀錄，記載誰拍攝、匯入與編輯了它，因此其來源可以被驗證，而不是只能被相信。

source: - **Share across servers.** People on different servers share albums with each other, the way email works between providers. Nobody has to join your server, and no company sits in the middle.
target: - **跨伺服器分享。** 位於不同伺服器的人可以互相分享相簿，就像電子郵件在不同服務供應商之間往來一樣。沒有人需要加入您的伺服器，也沒有任何公司介於其中。

source: - **Your whole library, even offline.** Every app keeps an index of everything you have ever kept, so you can browse, search and organize all of it on a plane, at the border, or far from any signal.
target: - **完整相片庫，離線也能用。** 每個應用程式都保存著您曾保留的所有相片的索引，因此無論在飛機上、在邊境，或遠離任何訊號，您都能瀏覽、搜尋與整理全部內容。

source: - **Straight from the camera.** Pull photos over Wi-Fi or cable directly from your camera, with every file checksummed on arrival.
target: - **直接從相機匯入。** 透過 Wi-Fi 或傳輸線直接從相機擷取相片，每個檔案抵達時都會以總和檢查碼驗證。

source: - **A library that outlives Capsule.** Every photo sits beside a signed sidecar in an open format, so your library stays readable without the app, without the database, and without us.
target: - **比 Capsule 更長久的相片庫。** 每張相片旁都有一個採用開放格式的簽章附屬檔（sidecar），因此即使沒有應用程式、沒有資料庫、沒有我們，您的相片庫依然可讀。

source: - **Native on every device\*.** Real native apps that follow each platform's own design, a web viewer for anyone you share with, and a scriptable command line and terminal UI.
target: - **每部裝置上都是原生應用程式\*。** 遵循各平台自身設計規範的真正原生應用程式、供您的分享對象使用的 Web 檢視器，以及可撰寫指令碼的命令列與終端機介面。

source: \* Coming later, prioritized by demand.
target: \* 後續推出，依需求決定優先順序。

source: ## Everything you'd expect
target: ## 您期待的功能，一應俱全

source: - Albums, plus your originals kept byte for byte with their metadata and restorable exactly as they went in
target: - 相簿；原始檔連同中繼資料逐位元組保存，並能依匯入時的原樣還原

source: - Search by date, place, camera, lens, rating and label, run on your device
target: - 依日期、地點、相機、鏡頭、評分與標籤搜尋，全部在您的裝置上執行

source: - Ratings, picks and rejects for culling a shoot; labels and captions
target: - 用於篩選拍攝成果的評分、選用與淘汰標記；標籤與說明文字

source: - A map of where every photo was taken, with location fixes that keep the original
target: - 顯示每張相片拍攝地點的地圖，修正位置時會保留原始資訊

source: - Share links anyone can open in a browser, and upload links that let guests add their photos to yours
target: - 任何人都能在瀏覽器中開啟的分享連結，以及讓訪客把自己的相片加入您相片中的上傳連結

source: - Backups that resume where they stopped, and device-to-device sync over your local network
target: - 能從中斷處繼續的備份，以及透過區域網路進行的裝置間同步

source: - Trash with a recovery window, hidden photos, and account recovery if you lose a device
target: - 具復原期限的垃圾桶、隱藏相片，以及遺失裝置時的帳號復原

source: - Apps in 13 languages
target: - 支援 13 種語言的應用程式

source: ## On the roadmap
target: ## 路線圖

source: - **On-device AI.** Search in plain words ("sunset over the harbour"), find people, pets and places, and surface your best shots, all computed on your devices. AI suggestions are kept apart from your own labels and never overwrite them.
target: - **裝置端 AI。** 以日常用語搜尋（「港口上空的夕陽」），找出人物、寵物與地點，並挑出您的最佳作品，全部在您的裝置上運算完成。AI 建議與您自己的標籤分開存放，絕不會覆寫它們。

source: - **Built-in, format-aware image compression.** Choose lossless or lossy compression for each format, so a library takes less space on exactly your terms.
target: - **內建、依格式調整的影像壓縮。** 為每種格式選擇無損或有損壓縮，讓相片庫完全依您的意願節省空間。

source: - **More importers.** One-step moves from iCloud Photos and Immich, alongside Google Photos.
target: - **更多匯入工具。** 除了 Google 相簿，也能從 iCloud 照片與 Immich 一步搬移。

source: - **Windows and Linux apps**, after the phone, tablet and Mac apps.
target: - **Windows 與 Linux 應用程式**，將在手機、平板與 Mac 應用程式之後推出。

source: ## Get started
target: ## 開始使用

source: - **Try it.** The [getting-started guide](https://capsule.justinchung.net/guides/getting-started/) sets up a local library on your computer; no server is needed.
target: - **試用看看。** [入門指南](https://capsule.justinchung.net/guides/getting-started/)會在您的電腦上建立本機相片庫；不需要伺服器。

source: - **Bring your library.** Import folders, drives and memory cards, pull from a camera, or [move from Google Photos](https://capsule.justinchung.net/guides/google-photos-migration/).
target: - **帶來您的相片庫。** 匯入資料夾、硬碟與記憶卡，從相機擷取，或[從 Google 相簿搬移](https://capsule.justinchung.net/guides/google-photos-migration/)。

source: - **Run a server** for yourself, your family or your friends: [self-hosting](https://capsule.justinchung.net/guides/self-hosting/).
target: - **架設伺服器**，供您自己、家人或朋友使用：[自行代管](https://capsule.justinchung.net/guides/self-hosting/)。

source: - **See how it works** in the [design docs](https://capsule.justinchung.net/design/).
target: - **了解運作方式**，請參閱[設計文件](https://capsule.justinchung.net/design/)。

source: ## Contributing
target: ## 參與貢獻

source: Install [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev), run `mise install` and `mise run hooks-install`, then see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Report bugs in GitHub Issues; ask setup questions in GitHub Discussions. Contributions need a signed [CLA](CLA.md): a single copyright holder is what keeps app-store distribution possible, and every public release stays under an OSI-approved licence.
target: 安裝 [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev)，執行 `mise install` 與 `mise run hooks-install`，然後參閱 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。請在 GitHub Issues 回報錯誤；在 GitHub Discussions 提出設定方面的問題。貢獻需要簽署 [CLA](CLA.md)：由單一著作權持有人持有著作權，才能確保應用程式商店散布成為可能，且每個公開版本都維持在 OSI 核准的授權之下。

source:
| Path | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `capsule-core` | Rust core: cryptography, media, metadata, local library |
| `capsule-sdk` | Rust client SDK over the generated API client |
| `capsule-cli` | The `capsule` CLI and TUI |
| `capsule-server` | The server (Kynos REST/OpenAPI) |
| `capsule-e2e` | End-to-end tests across the real binaries |
| `capsule-swift`, `capsule-android` | Native Apple and Android clients |
| `capsule-web` | Read-only web client |
| `capsule-docs` | Documentation site |
